assumptions: Order placement date taken as orders.order_date
Revenue computed as sum of quantity * unit_price across order lines; not net of returns
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents), 0) AS total_cents
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE o.customer_region = 'APAC'
  AND o.status = 'closed'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01'
  AND o.order_date <= '2026-06-30';
